author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
I'm so excited to share with you all that I've been sponsored by Monolith Board Games and Rackham Studio to talk about one of my all-time favourite game properties; CONFRONTATION. In the build up to its new edition next year, I'm going to be doing a whole series covering the history of the game, the impact it had on the industry and revisit some of its greatest hits. 

If you want to help shape the future of Aarklash you can vote on which two final factions come out in the first wave of armies HERE: https://gamefound.com/en/projects/monolith-board-games-sarl/incarnation/updates/3

GMG is publicly supported. Become a backer on Patreon to ensure new content and that the Studio can continue: https://www.patreon.com/guerrillaminiaturegames 

Join us on DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/XTqqxctryq

Want to challenge Ash to a game? Email him at GuerrillaMiniatureGames@gmail.com or message him through his Facebook Page!

title: Let's talk about Confrontation... and INCARNATION!
